name: Plant Nerd | Papaya Bomb
description: Papaya x THC Bomb by Purple City Genetics. The reason we added this strain to our production is simple, we just really like it! The nose hits you with a skunky, fruity papaya punch and has the terpene content to really make it land. The flower is dense, big buds that are mostly green with dense trichome coverage.
